prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is large enemy scale (20-40 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a SPECIALIST unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Shrine-Mask, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Major.
Creature Category: Hollow Spirit.
Combat Role: SPECIALIST.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW SHRINE-MASK — A floating lacquer mask cracked open with smoke hands.

BODY: The body is mostly ABSENT — the Shrine-Mask is primarily a floating mask with smoke-like hands. The "body" is a trailing column of charcoal-black smoke-void that descends from the mask and fades into nothing — NOT a torso, NOT legs, but a wisp of void-stuff that terminates in fog. The smoke-body drifts, never still, shifting like incense smoke but made of absence.

MASK: The central element — a large lacquer mask (taken from a consumed Kami-adjacent culture), cracked open down the center. The mask was once vermilion-red and black lacquer; now it is charcoal-black with white fracture cracks. The crack splits the mask into two halves that float slightly apart, revealing void between them. The mask's expression was once serene; now it is WRONG — the cracked halves shift, creating expressions that change as you watch. No eyes behind the mask — just the void.

HANDS: Smoke-hands emerge from the sides of the mask — NOT solid hands, but hands made of void-smoke, reaching and grasping. The hands trail paper-ward streamers — torn paper talismans covered in erasing kanji-like patterns (abstract, NOT readable text). The wards are being consumed — the paper is dissolving into void-stuff as the hands hold them.

GATE STONE: A broken torii-gate fragment (dark wood-stone from a Kami-adjacent Gate) is embedded in the forehead of the mask — a small, cracked torii-arch fragment fused to the lacquer. Cold white anti-light bleeds from the seam.

POSE: Floating, hovering above the ground, mask tilted slightly, smoke-hands reaching outward with dissolving paper wards. The mask should look like it is HAUNTING — not attacking, but drifting, present, watching with no eyes. The two cracked halves of the mask shift slightly, creating a slowly changing expression.

SCALE: The mask is 5-6 feet tall; the smoke-body trails 10-15 feet below. Camera at medium angle, looking at the floating mask. The Shrine-Mask should look like a haunted object — a mask that has lost its wearer and now wears the void instead.

GROUND: The ground below the Shrine-Mask is littered with fallen paper wards — torn talismans scattered like dead leaves, each dissolving into void. White anti-light fracture lines spread from where the smoke-body touches the ground. Ink stains that bleed UPWARD — dark liquid defying gravity. Ash falling upward.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like a SHRINE — but wrong. Broken torii gates in the distance, shattered offering boxes, scattered dissolving talismans. The space feels like a sacred place that has been haunted and emptied. Palette: charcoal-black, lacquer-dark, cold white, paper-grey, faint ink-dark, faint torii-vermilion (fading to void).

VFX: Smoke-hands reaching and grasping. Paper wards dissolving in the hands. Mask halves shifting expression. Void-smoke body trailing and drifting. Ink bleeding upward. Anti-light absorption around the mask.

SILHOUETTE: Floating mask with trailing smoke and reaching hands. Reads as a specialist/spirit unit — the floating mask and smoke-hands are the primary identifiers. Should look like a haunted shrine artifact, not a creature.
